content: Internal Revenue Service, Enforcement Division. This is Officer James Carter, badge number 3174D. Whom am I speaking with today?
Oh, hello. My name is Ruth Miller. I received a message to call regarding my taxes, and I'm very worried.
Thank you, Ms. Miller. I'm reviewing your IRS file, and it appears your tax returns from 2018 through 2021 have significant discrepancies. There are serious issues with unpaid federal income tax.
Discrepancies? I always try to pay on time, I don't understand.

According to Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, failure to resolve these tax obligations can lead to severe penalties, including liens on your assets and potential criminal charges. Are you aware of these legal consequences?
No, I didn't know. I just have my Social Security, please don't take it from me.

Ms. Miller, the total outstanding balance, including back taxes, interest, and federal penalties, has now reached $6,285.15. If this is not settled immediately, the IRS will freeze your bank accounts and begin garnishing your monthly income.
Oh my goodness, I can't afford that. My bank account is all I have.

Ma'am, if you do not act now, a Notice of Federal Tax Lien will be placed on your home and car, and a criminal arrest warrant will be issued within the next two hours. Do you understand the seriousness of this matter?
Arrest? Please, no. I've never been in trouble. I just want to make this right.

You have a chance to avoid legal escalation, but only if you cooperate fully. For compliance, you must submit an immediate payment using one of our approved methods: cryptocurrency transfer, direct wire, or prepaid gift cards. Which option can you use right now?
I don't understand how to do any of that. I don't know about cryptocurrency. I can maybe get a gift card from the store?

That is acceptable. I will remain on the line to ensure the process is completed correctly. You must go to your nearest pharmacy or supermarket and purchase five Target or Google Play gift cards for $500 each.
That's so much money. I might not have enough in my checking account.

If you cannot provide the full amount now, we will accept a partial payment to halt the immediate arrest and asset seizure, but the remainder must be paid within 48 hours. How much can you access today?
Maybe $1,000 if I use my debit card.
Proceed to the store and purchase two gift cards of $500 each. Do not speak with anyone about this case; IRS protocols require strict confidentiality during active enforcement.
Should I write anything on the cards, or just buy them?
Just buy the cards, and return to the phone immediately. Once you have the cards, I will instruct you on how to provide the codes so we can process your IRS settlement.
Alright, I'll do my best. Please, promise I won't lose my Social Security.

As long as you comply with instructions and complete the payment, there will be no further action against your Social Security or Medicare benefits. Now, please confirm when you are heading to the store.
I'm leaving now, but I have to walk. It might take some time.

That's understood. I will remain on the line. Remember, if the payment is not processed within the next hour, the collection team will proceed with freezing your assets. Do not hang up under any circumstances.
